models.title: Direct rank access versus successor traversal
models.invariant: The list cursor is at the node reached by the stated number of links; array indices do not traverse nodes.
models.assumptions: Exclusive access; word-sized slots and pointers; finite illustrative state. Exact counting convention appears in each caption.
